notes: Coinbase is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Coinbase with symbol COINBASE and 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. Transfers deliver the exact requested amount without fees or burns. There are no public mint or burn functions, administrative roles, pause or blacklist controls, or upgrade mechanisms. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs with IMD at the supplied address with a 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
